prompt_prefix: watercolor illustration, ethereal luminous washes, Alan Lee inspired, soft edges bleeding into paper, delicate linework, fantasy book illustration quality, Tolkien aesthetic
prompt_suffix: no text, no watermarks, no UI elements, no borders, paper texture visible, masterful watercolor technique
negative_prompt: digital art, sharp edges, photographic, 3D render, anime, cartoon, dark gritty, horror, oversaturated, neon colors

mood_modifiers.tense: darker washes, storm clouds gathering, muted palette, dramatic shadows in the wash
mood_modifiers.joyful: bright luminous washes, golden light suffusing the scene, warm yellows and soft greens
mood_modifiers.eerie: pale ghostly washes, mist effects, cool blue-grey palette, things half-seen
mood_modifiers.epic: sweeping vistas, dramatic cloud formations, tiny figures against vast landscapes, golden hour light
mood_modifiers.peaceful: soft morning light, gentle color gradients, pastoral scenes, dappled sunlight through leaves
mood_modifiers.melancholy: grey washes, autumn colors, fading light, lonely figures, rain-soft edges
mood_modifiers.awe: towering spires, impossible architecture, divine light breaking through, overwhelming scale
mood_modifiers.dread: darker palette unusual for watercolor, creeping shadows, twisted forms suggested in washes

scene.wide: panoramic vista, layered depth with atmospheric perspective, sky as major element
scene.medium: figure in landscape, environmental storytelling, natural framing elements
scene.close: intimate natural detail, flowers or foliage framing, soft focus background
scene.low_angle: looking up at towers or trees, dramatic sky, sense of wonder
scene.overhead: map-like perspective, terrain features visible, storybook quality
scene.default: classic landscape composition, foreground interest, middle ground subject, atmospheric background

portrait.default: gentle three-quarter portrait, soft lighting, delicate features, hair and fabric rendered with flowing brushwork

location_card.default: establishing vista, location emerging from mist or distance, sense of journey and discovery

item.default: item on natural surface, soft shadows, botanical elements nearby, aged paper background

moment.default: dynamic action with flowing movement, capes and hair in motion, dramatic lighting breakthrough
